title: Preparation scan configurations
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and let $w$ and $s$ be Boolean words. For every $j\in\mathbb N$ with $j\le |s|$, running the preparation machine for $j$ steps from the configuration in state $(0,\mathrm{false})$ with the candidate on the first work tape and all other work tapes blank, input head at position $1$, and work heads at position $0$, yields the configuration in state $(0,|w|<j)$ whose input head is at the saturated position for $j$, whose first work tape still stores $s$, whose scratch tapes store the unary word of length $j$, and whose work heads are all at displacement $j$.
replaced:
For every $j$ at most the candidate's length, $j$ steps of the preparation
machine from the start of its scan yield the preparation scan configuration
for $j$; the candidate is unchanged and nothing is emitted, and this holds
also for candidates longer than the native input.
